messages:
Alex R.: deploybot just paused slot 14 — incident in us-west-controlplane. holding any releases that touch the controlplane API. assigning ops to triage, please confirm impact and share ETA.

deploybot: Release slot 14 paused by @Alex R. (reason: incident detected in us-west-controlplane)

Priya (oncall): looking. seeing repeated leader election timeouts after the db failover at 03:12. queueing a quick investigation; initial suspicion is a KV cache mismatch causing API sync delays. ETA 45m for a mitigation (rolling restart + cache clear).

Mateo G.: if we can't fix in 45, can we pin upcoming releases to prior controlplane v2.4.1 so they don't touch the changed components? we have one canary (slot 15) targeting 2.5.x.

Jordan L.: we can pin the release versions in the deploy manifest, but need explicit approval to skip the standard canary. alternative: re-route slot 15 to region eu-central to avoid us-west impact.

Casey M.: customer comms question — do we notify customers about deferred releases or only if SLAs are affected? Also need to freeze release notes edits until we confirm versions.

Alex R.: good points. Plan proposal:
- hold slot 14 (paused) until Priya confirms mitigation and we validate controlplane health.
- pin slot 15 to v2.4.1 (previous stable) and move its canary to eu-central as a precaution. if pin fails, we'll defer slot 15 by +2h and requeue in staggered slots.
- freeze release notes for these builds (Casey, please hold).

Priya (oncall): confirmed scope: controlplane API pods showing higher restart loops on leader election. mitigation attempt scheduled at +20m: coordinated rolling restart with cache flush flags. I'll post back on result.

Mateo G.: OK I'll prepare a pin PR for slot 15: branch name `pin/slot-15-controlplane-2.4.1`. Will not merge until Alex approves.

Jordan L.: deploybot commands ready. suggested commands:```
/deploy pin-slot 15 --version 2.4.1 --reason "incident mitigation"
/deploy move-canary 15 --region eu-central
/deploy defer 16 --by 120m --stagger 15
```

Alex R.: @deploybot run the pin + move-canary commands as a trial (dry-run) and show the plan. we'll only execute if Priya gives green.

deploybot: Dry-run results:
- slot 15 pin to 2.4.1: OK (no conflicts)
- move canary 15 -> eu-central: scheduling available (no infra constraints)
- defer 16 by 120m with stagger: queued

SREBot: Alert rule: controlplane_leader_election_fail_rate triggered (us-west-controlplane) at 03:14. Current fail rate 12%.

Priya (oncall): rolling restart + cache-flush executed at 03:32. monitoring logs now. initial errors dropping, leader election failures down to 2% after cache clear. still watching for 2 full minutes of steady-state before recommending unpause.

Alex R.: thanks. assuming steady-state holds, we will:
1) unpause slot 14 and gate release through a single canary wave (5% traffic)
2) apply pin for slot 15 and move canary to eu-central (execute now)
3) defer slot 16 by 2h and stagger subsequent slots by 15m to avoid burst load on controlplane.

Casey M.: understood. I'll send a short internal note: "Releases touching controlplane deferred; canary moved to eu-central; pin applied to slot 15. Holding public release notes until we confirm post-canary stability."

Mateo G.: Alex — I've opened PR and added testing checklist. URL: https://git.redwood/repo/pulls/4822 (not a real link in thread).

deploybot: Executing commands: pin-slot 15 -> 2.4.1; move-canary 15 -> eu-central; defer 16 by 120m with stagger 15m.

deploybot: Command results: pin-slot 15 SUCCESS, move-canary 15 SUCCESS, defer 16 SUCCESS.

Priya (oncall): steady-state met at 03:40. leader election fail rate stable <1.5% for 3 consecutive minutes. recommend unpause.

Alex R.: OK unpausing slot 14 now with canary gate. Please monitor metrics (latency, error-rate, leader-election) during the gate. If we see any regression, we'll immediate abort and roll back to 2.4.1.

deploybot: Unpause request for slot 14 accepted. Canary gate applied: 5% traffic for 10m.

Jordan L.: monitor dashboard links: https://metrics.redwood/dashboard/controlplane and https://metrics.redwood/dashboard/releases. will watch infra scaling to ensure circuit breakers don't trip.

Casey M.: I'll wait for canary pass before sharing the deferred release schedule with PMs.

Alex R.: final note: postmortem not needed yet, but capture timeline in the incident board and include decision to pin and stagger requeue. Priya, Mateo — please add short notes to the incident doc.

Priya (oncall): will add logs/timestamps. thanks everyone.

Mateo G.: thanks.

Alex R.: closing thread — reopening if anything flares up. :white_check_mark:
